issue.description:
ADR-002 makes a reconciliation report the mandatory artifact of rehydration — every source identifier mapped to a native identifier or an explicit omitted/merged/unresolved disposition, with source repository and commit recorded — but documents no format, template, or completeness validation, so each agent invents its own. Define the versioned report schema, publish a template and a worked example under docs/, and document where the report lives and how a reviewer validates it against the source inventory (including the batching and duplicate-detection cases ADR-002 flags for large repositories).

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Specify the versioned reconciliation-report format for agent-guided rehydration (ADR-002)
